class.name: NetwInterpolate
class.brief_description: How one replicated value is smoothed on its way to the property that shows it.
class.description: [NetwInterpolate] names how one decoded value enters the interpolation history. [member target] names the property that receives the smoothed output. [member mode], [member smoothing], and [member snap_distance] are read by the session's display pump as each sample is recorded. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").interpolate( NetwInterpolate.new().lerp().smooth(0.05).to(&"position") ) [/codeblock] The same resource shape is used by [method Netw.configure_property], [method Netw.configure_rpc], and [method Netw.configure_signal]. When [member NetwDisplayHandle.visual_root] is set the visual keeps inheriting the body transform and spatial values are written in global space, so a smoothed channel is not dragged by body writes. Add a second [NetwInterpolate] to also smooth [code]rotation[/code].

method.name: hold
method.description: Selects [constant TAIL_HOLD] so the channel never projects past its newest sample, for discrete or flag values that must not extrapolate.

method.name: is_same_spec
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param other] declares the same smoothing behavior. Compared by value, so a freshly built spec equal to a stored one is recognized as the same declaration and re-applying it is idempotent.

method.name: project_by
method.description: Projects the forecast tail using sibling [param channel] as the derivative. The named channel should replicate this value's velocity at the same authoring tick. Leaving it unset projects by finite difference instead.

method.name: smoothing_weight
method.description: How far one frame of [param frame_delta] seconds moves the display toward its sampled target, given [member smoothing]. Frame-rate independent by construction: two frames of half the delta compose to the same weight as one whole frame, so a display filtered here looks the same at any frame rate. A channel with no [member smoothing] takes the whole step.

members.member: Tail policy under a forecasting playhead. [constant TAIL_AUTO] projects, [constant TAIL_HOLD] never does. Ignored while the entity buffers.
Interpolation algorithm used for this value.

Sibling channel whose sampled value is this channel's derivative. Empty falls back to the finite difference of the last two samples. Set it through [method project_by] to a channel that replicates velocity at the same authoring tick, so a torn pair never manufactures a phantom trajectory.
Exponential smoothing time in seconds layered onto bracketed interpolation.
Distance that snaps instead of interpolating. [code]0.0[/code] disables it.
Property receiving the smoothed output. Empty means the source property name for [method Netw.configure_property]. RPC and signal arguments should set an explicit [member target].

constants.constant: Extrapolates past the newest sample by its derivative, capped by [constant NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_PARAM_MAX_FORECAST_TICKS]. The derivative is [member project_channel] when set, otherwise the finite difference of the last two samples.
Holds the newest sample and never projects, for discrete or flag values.
